sections.title: A flat list of paths and roles
body: Rules are prefix-matched and evaluated deepest path first. A rule can make a path public, require any signed-in user, or require specific roles, with an optional per-route fallback.
sections.caption: Every route rule collects into one panel.

sections.title: 200, 401 or 403, with a redirect
body: Allowed routes return 200. Not signed in returns 401 and a redirect to login. Signed in with the wrong role returns 403 and a redirect to the unauthorized page or home.
sections.caption: Two arrows: 401 to login, 403 for wrong role.

sections.title: Automatically, or on its own
body: kavach.handle uses the sentry automatically in your SvelteKit hooks; you can also use @kavach/sentry standalone.
sections.caption: Nested paths light up to the deepest match.
